name: CS Diagnostics Corp.
summary: Headquartered in Neuss, Germany, CS Diagnostics Corp. was established in 1996. The company is dedicated to the development, production, and worldwide distribution of a range of health and medical-grade products, catering to both domestic German and international markets. Among its key offerings are MEDUSA, an exclusive surface disinfectant, and CS-Protect Hydrogel, a specialized tissue-spacing gel for radiation therapy applications. The firm rebranded as CS Diagnostics Corp. in August 2023, having previously operated under the name FlashZero Corp.
